title: Student Startup & Entrepreneurship Financials 🚀
description: Burn Rate, Runway, Bootstrapping vs Funding, Cap Table, Pitch Deck, and DPIIT Startup India benefits.

cards.title: Runway & Burn Rate Formula 📉
cards.content:
Startup Death Reason #1: **Running out of Cash!**

**Burn Rate**: Monthly Cash Outflow - Monthly Cash Inflow.
**Runway (Months)**: Total Bank Cash Balance ÷ Net Monthly Burn Rate.

Example: ₹6 Lakh bank balance ÷ ₹50,000 monthly burn = **12 Months Runway**.
cards.imagePrompt: Rocket flying over runway marked with months timeline, purple and neon vector

cards.title: Bootstrapping vs VC Equity Dilution 🤝
cards.content:
Early valuation ₹50 Lakh par 20% equity bechna = **₹10 Lakh for 20%**.
Baad mein valuation ₹10 Crore hogi toh us 20% ki value **₹2 Crore** ban jayegi!

Rule: Bootstrapping se PMF (Product Market Fit) tak pahuncho pehle, seed raise tab karo jab scale karna ho.
cards.imagePrompt: Pie chart being sliced into equity portions, purple and gold theme

choiceData.scenario: Idea stage hai, Angel investor ₹5L de raha hai 30% equity ke liye. Deal ya No Deal?

choices.text: Deal! Pehla paisa mil raha hai le lo
choices.consequence: Equity Trap! 30% dilution at idea stage VC rounds block kar dega.

choices.text: No Deal! College grant / Bootstrapping se MVP banao
choices.consequence: Smart Founder! MVP launch karke higher valuation par raise karo.

cards.title: 🚨 MISSION: DPIIT Startup Registration
cards.content:
🚨 **TODAY'S MISSION**

Startup Setup Checklist:

- [ ] DPIIT Startup India portal (startupindia.gov.in) pe register karo.
- [ ] 3-year Tax Exemption (Section 80-IAC) application eligibility check.
- [ ] Founder Vesting Agreement sign karo (4-year vesting, 1-year cliff).
- [ ] Separate Current Account & CA consultation setup.
